name: hold
turns: Thank you for calling Meridian Voice Support, this is Priya. How can I help you today?
Hi Priya, this is Rosa Delgado at Harbor Vet Clinic. Our call recordings stopped showing up in the portal last Friday.
I'm sorry about that, Rosa. Can you confirm the main number on the account?
It's four one five, five five five, zero one eight eight.
Thank you. I need to check the recording settings on our side. Can I place you on a brief hold?
Thanks for holding, Rosa. Recording is still turned on for all of your users, and the recordings are being saved.
Then why can't we see them?
That's what I'm checking. Have any of your staff changed roles recently?
Actually, yes. Our office manager was promoted to practice director on Friday.
That lines up. The portal access for the practice director role was changed the same day. I want to find out who made that change. One more short hold, please.
Thank you for waiting. The change was part of a permissions update on our side, and it removed recording access from that role by mistake. I've restored it.
Let me check. Yes, I can see last week's recordings now.
Great. I've also added a note so the next update doesn't affect your account.
Perfect. Thanks for your help, Priya.
You're welcome, Rosa. Have a great day.
